[294](https://time-rs.github.io#294)    /// Create a `Date` from the Julian day.
[295](https://time-rs.github.io#295)    ///
[296](https://time-rs.github.io#296)    /// # Safety
[297](https://time-rs.github.io#297)    ///
[298](https://time-rs.github.io#298)    /// The provided Julian day number must be between `Date::MIN.to_julian_day()` and
[299](https://time-rs.github.io#299)    /// `Date::MAX.to_julian_day()` inclusive.
[300](https://time-rs.github.io#300)    #[inline]
[301](https://time-rs.github.io#301)    pub(crate) const unsafe fn from_julian_day_unchecked(julian_day: [i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html)) -> Self {
[302](https://time-rs.github.io#302)        [debug_assert!](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/macro.debug_assert.html)(julian_day >= Self::MIN.to_julian_day());
[303](https://time-rs.github.io#303)        [debug_assert!](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/macro.debug_assert.html)(julian_day <= Self::MAX.to_julian_day());
[304](https://time-rs.github.io#304)
[305](https://time-rs.github.io#305)        const ERAS: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = 5_949;
[306](https://time-rs.github.io#306)        // Rata Die shift:
[307](https://time-rs.github.io#307)        const D_SHIFT: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = 146097 * [ERAS](https://time-rs.github.io#305) - 1_721_060;
[308](https://time-rs.github.io#308)        // Year shift:
[309](https://time-rs.github.io#309)        const Y_SHIFT: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = 400 * [ERAS](https://time-rs.github.io#305);
[310](https://time-rs.github.io#310)
[311](https://time-rs.github.io#311)        const CEN_MUL: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = ((4u64 << 47) / 146_097) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[312](https://time-rs.github.io#312)        const JUL_MUL: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = ((4u64 << 40) / 1_461 + 1) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[313](https://time-rs.github.io#313)        const CEN_CUT: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = ((365u64 << 32) / 36_525) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[314](https://time-rs.github.io#314)
[315](https://time-rs.github.io#315)        let day = [julian_day](https://time-rs.github.io#301).[cast_unsigned](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.i32.html#method.cast_unsigned)().[wrapping_add](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.wrapping_add)([D_SHIFT](https://time-rs.github.io#307));
[316](https://time-rs.github.io#316)        let c_n = ([day](https://time-rs.github.io#315) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html) * [CEN_MUL](https://time-rs.github.io#311) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html)) >> 15;
[317](https://time-rs.github.io#317)        let cen = ([c_n](https://time-rs.github.io#316) >> 32) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[318](https://time-rs.github.io#318)        let cpt = [c_n](https://time-rs.github.io#316) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[319](https://time-rs.github.io#319)        let ijy = [cpt](https://time-rs.github.io#318) > [CEN_CUT](https://time-rs.github.io#313) || [cen](https://time-rs.github.io#317).[is_multiple_of](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.is_multiple_of)(4);
[320](https://time-rs.github.io#320)        let jul = [day](https://time-rs.github.io#315) - [cen](https://time-rs.github.io#317) / 4 + [cen](https://time-rs.github.io#317);
[321](https://time-rs.github.io#321)        let y_n = ([jul](https://time-rs.github.io#320) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html) * [JUL_MUL](https://time-rs.github.io#312) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html)) >> 8;
[322](https://time-rs.github.io#322)        let yrs = ([y_n](https://time-rs.github.io#321) >> 32) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[323](https://time-rs.github.io#323)        let ypt = [y_n](https://time-rs.github.io#321) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[324](https://time-rs.github.io#324)
[325](https://time-rs.github.io#325)        let year = [yrs](https://time-rs.github.io#322).[wrapping_sub](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.wrapping_sub)([Y_SHIFT](https://time-rs.github.io#309)).[cast_signed](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.cast_signed)();
[326](https://time-rs.github.io#326)        let ordinal = (([ypt](https://time-rs.github.io#323) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html) * 1_461) >> 34) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) + [ijy](https://time-rs.github.io#319) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[327](https://time-rs.github.io#327)        let leap = [yrs](https://time-rs.github.io#322).[is_multiple_of](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.is_multiple_of)(4) & [ijy](https://time-rs.github.io#319);
[328](https://time-rs.github.io#328)
[329](https://time-rs.github.io#329)        // Safety: `ordinal` is not zero and `is_leap_year` is correct, so long as the Julian day
[330](https://time-rs.github.io#330)        // number is in range, which is guaranteed by the caller.
[331](https://time-rs.github.io#331)        unsafe { Self::[from_parts](https://time-rs.github.io#98-111)([year](https://time-rs.github.io#325), [leap](https://time-rs.github.io#327), [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#326) as [u16](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u16.html)) }
[332](https://time-rs.github.io#332)    }

[334](https://time-rs.github.io#334)    /// Whether `is_leap_year(self.year())` is `true`.

[339](https://time-rs.github.io#339)    const fn is_in_leap_year(self) -> [bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html) {

[341](https://time-rs.github.io#341)    }

[356](https://time-rs.github.io#356)    /// Get the month.
[357](https://time-rs.github.io#357)    ///
[358](https://time-rs.github.io#358)    /// ```rust
[359](https://time-rs.github.io#359)    /// # use time::Month;
[360](https://time-rs.github.io#360)    /// # use time_macros::date;
[361](https://time-rs.github.io#361)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-01-01).month(), Month::January);
[362](https://time-rs.github.io#362)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-12-31).month(), Month::December);
[363](https://time-rs.github.io#363)    /// ```
[364](https://time-rs.github.io#364)    #[inline]
[365](https://time-rs.github.io#365)    pub const fn month(self) -> [Month](https://time-rs.github.io/month.rs.html#15-40) {
[366](https://time-rs.github.io#366)        let ordinal = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#365).[ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#423-425)() as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[367](https://time-rs.github.io#367)        let jan_feb_len = 59 + [self](https://time-rs.github.io#365).[is_in_leap_year](https://time-rs.github.io#339-341)() as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[368](https://time-rs.github.io#368)
[369](https://time-rs.github.io#369)        let (month_adj, ordinal_adj) = if [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#366) <= [jan_feb_len](https://time-rs.github.io#367) {
[370](https://time-rs.github.io#370)            (0, 0)
[371](https://time-rs.github.io#371)        } else {
[372](https://time-rs.github.io#372)            (2, [jan_feb_len](https://time-rs.github.io#367))
[373](https://time-rs.github.io#373)        };
[374](https://time-rs.github.io#374)
[375](https://time-rs.github.io#375)        let ordinal = [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#366) - [ordinal_adj](https://time-rs.github.io#369);
[376](https://time-rs.github.io#376)        let month = (([ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#375) * 268 + 8031) >> 13) + [month_adj](https://time-rs.github.io#369);
[377](https://time-rs.github.io#377)
[378](https://time-rs.github.io#378)        // Safety: `month` is guaranteed to be between 1 and 12 inclusive.
[379](https://time-rs.github.io#379)        unsafe {
[380](https://time-rs.github.io#380)            match [Month](https://time-rs.github.io/month.rs.html#15-40)::[from_number](https://time-rs.github.io/month.rs.html#45-61)([NonZero](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/num/nonzero/struct.NonZero.html)::[new_unchecked](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/num/nonzero/struct.NonZero.html#method.new_unchecked)([month](https://time-rs.github.io#376) as [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html))) {
[381](https://time-rs.github.io#381)                [Ok](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html#variant.Ok)(month) => [month](https://time-rs.github.io#381),
[382](https://time-rs.github.io#382)                [Err](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html#variant.Err)(_) => core::hint::[unreachable_unchecked](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/hint/fn.unreachable_unchecked.html)(),
[383](https://time-rs.github.io#383)            }
[384](https://time-rs.github.io#384)        }
[385](https://time-rs.github.io#385)    }

[387](https://time-rs.github.io#387)    /// Get the day of the month.
[388](https://time-rs.github.io#388)    ///
[389](https://time-rs.github.io#389)    /// The returned value will always be in the range `1..=31`.
[390](https://time-rs.github.io#390)    ///
[391](https://time-rs.github.io#391)    /// ```rust
[392](https://time-rs.github.io#392)    /// # use time_macros::date;
[393](https://time-rs.github.io#393)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-01-01).day(), 1);
[394](https://time-rs.github.io#394)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-12-31).day(), 31);
[395](https://time-rs.github.io#395)    /// ```
[396](https://time-rs.github.io#396)    #[inline]
[397](https://time-rs.github.io#397)    pub const fn day(self) -> [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html) {
[398](https://time-rs.github.io#398)        let ordinal = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#397).[ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#423-425)() as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[399](https://time-rs.github.io#399)        let jan_feb_len = 59 + [self](https://time-rs.github.io#397).[is_in_leap_year](https://time-rs.github.io#339-341)() as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[400](https://time-rs.github.io#400)
[401](https://time-rs.github.io#401)        let ordinal_adj = if [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#398) <= [jan_feb_len](https://time-rs.github.io#399) {
[402](https://time-rs.github.io#402)            0
[403](https://time-rs.github.io#403)        } else {
[404](https://time-rs.github.io#404)            [jan_feb_len](https://time-rs.github.io#399)
[405](https://time-rs.github.io#405)        };
[406](https://time-rs.github.io#406)
[407](https://time-rs.github.io#407)        let ordinal = [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#398) - [ordinal_adj](https://time-rs.github.io#401);
[408](https://time-rs.github.io#408)        let month = ([ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#407) * 268 + 8031) >> 13;
[409](https://time-rs.github.io#409)        let days_in_preceding_months = ([month](https://time-rs.github.io#408) * 3917 - 3866) >> 7;
[410](https://time-rs.github.io#410)        ([ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#407) - [days_in_preceding_months](https://time-rs.github.io#409)) as [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html)
[411](https://time-rs.github.io#411)    }

[433](https://time-rs.github.io#433)            0 => ([year](https://time-rs.github.io#430) - 1, [weeks_in_year](https://time-rs.github.io/time/util/fn.weeks_in_year.html)([year](https://time-rs.github.io#430) - 1)),

[435](https://time-rs.github.io#435)            week => ([year](https://time-rs.github.io#430), [week](https://time-rs.github.io#435)),
[436](https://time-rs.github.io#436)        }

[506](https://time-rs.github.io#506)        let (month_adj, ordinal_adj) = if [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#503) <= [jan_feb_len](https://time-rs.github.io#504) {

[531](https://time-rs.github.io#531)    /// Get the year and ordinal day number.
[532](https://time-rs.github.io#532)    ///
[533](https://time-rs.github.io#533)    /// ```rust
[534](https://time-rs.github.io#534)    /// # use time_macros::date;

[542](https://time-rs.github.io#542)    /// Get the ISO 8601 year, week number, and weekday.
[543](https://time-rs.github.io#543)    ///
[544](https://time-rs.github.io#544)    /// ```rust
[545](https://time-rs.github.io#545)    /// # use time::Weekday::*;
[546](https://time-rs.github.io#546)    /// # use time_macros::date;
[547](https://time-rs.github.io#547)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-01-01).to_iso_week_date(), (2019, 1, Tuesday));
[548](https://time-rs.github.io#548)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-10-04).to_iso_week_date(), (2019, 40, Friday));
[549](https://time-rs.github.io#549)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2020-01-01).to_iso_week_date(), (2020, 1, Wednesday));
[550](https://time-rs.github.io#550)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2020-12-31).to_iso_week_date(), (2020, 53, Thursday));
[551](https://time-rs.github.io#551)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2021-01-01).to_iso_week_date(), (2020, 53, Friday));
[552](https://time-rs.github.io#552)    /// ```
[553](https://time-rs.github.io#553)    #[inline]
[554](https://time-rs.github.io#554)    pub const fn to_iso_week_date(self) -> ([i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html), [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html), [Weekday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#17-32)) {
[555](https://time-rs.github.io#555)        let (year, ordinal) = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#554).[to_ordinal_date](https://time-rs.github.io#538-540)();
[556](https://time-rs.github.io#556)        let weekday = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#554).[weekday](https://time-rs.github.io#584-597)();
[557](https://time-rs.github.io#557)
[558](https://time-rs.github.io#558)        match (([ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#555) + 10 - [weekday](https://time-rs.github.io#556).[number_from_monday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#127-129)() as [u16](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u16.html)) / 7) as [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html) {
[559](https://time-rs.github.io#559)            0 => ([year](https://time-rs.github.io#555) - 1, [weeks_in_year](https://time-rs.github.io/time/util/fn.weeks_in_year.html)([year](https://time-rs.github.io#555) - 1), [weekday](https://time-rs.github.io#556)),
[560](https://time-rs.github.io#560)            53 if [weeks_in_year](https://time-rs.github.io/time/util/fn.weeks_in_year.html)([year](https://time-rs.github.io#555)) == 52 => ([year](https://time-rs.github.io#555) + 1, 1, [weekday](https://time-rs.github.io#556)),
[561](https://time-rs.github.io#561)            week => ([year](https://time-rs.github.io#555), [week](https://time-rs.github.io#561), [weekday](https://time-rs.github.io#556)),
[562](https://time-rs.github.io#562)        }
[563](https://time-rs.github.io#563)    }

[565](https://time-rs.github.io#565)    /// Get the weekday.

[567](https://time-rs.github.io#567)    /// ```rust
[568](https://time-rs.github.io#568)    /// # use time::Weekday::*;
[569](https://time-rs.github.io#569)    /// # use time_macros::date;

[571](https://time-rs.github.io#571)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-02-01).weekday(), Friday);
[572](https://time-rs.github.io#572)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-03-01).weekday(), Friday);
[573](https://time-rs.github.io#573)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-04-01).weekday(), Monday);
[574](https://time-rs.github.io#574)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-05-01).weekday(), Wednesday);
[575](https://time-rs.github.io#575)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-06-01).weekday(), Saturday);
[576](https://time-rs.github.io#576)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-07-01).weekday(), Monday);
[577](https://time-rs.github.io#577)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-08-01).weekday(), Thursday);
[578](https://time-rs.github.io#578)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-09-01).weekday(), Sunday);
[579](https://time-rs.github.io#579)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-10-01).weekday(), Tuesday);
[580](https://time-rs.github.io#580)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-11-01).weekday(), Friday);
[581](https://time-rs.github.io#581)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-12-01).weekday(), Sunday);
[582](https://time-rs.github.io#582)    /// ```
[583](https://time-rs.github.io#583)    #[inline]
[584](https://time-rs.github.io#584)    pub const fn weekday(self) -> [Weekday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#17-32) {
[585](https://time-rs.github.io#585)        match [self](https://time-rs.github.io#584).[to_julian_day](https://time-rs.github.io#765-775)() % 7 {
[586](https://time-rs.github.io#586)            -6 | 1 => Weekday::[Tuesday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#21),
[587](https://time-rs.github.io#587)            -5 | 2 => Weekday::[Wednesday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#23),
[588](https://time-rs.github.io#588)            -4 | 3 => Weekday::[Thursday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#25),
[589](https://time-rs.github.io#589)            -3 | 4 => Weekday::[Friday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#27),
[590](https://time-rs.github.io#590)            -2 | 5 => Weekday::[Saturday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#29),
[591](https://time-rs.github.io#591)            -1 | 6 => Weekday::[Sunday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#31),
[592](https://time-rs.github.io#592)            val => {
[593](https://time-rs.github.io#593)                [debug_assert!](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/macro.debug_assert.html)(val == 0);
[594](https://time-rs.github.io#594)                Weekday::[Monday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#19)
[595](https://time-rs.github.io#595)            }
[596](https://time-rs.github.io#596)        }
[597](https://time-rs.github.io#597)    }

[755](https://time-rs.github.io#755)    /// Get the Julian day for the date.
[756](https://time-rs.github.io#756)    ///
[757](https://time-rs.github.io#757)    /// ```rust
[758](https://time-rs.github.io#758)    /// # use time_macros::date;
[759](https://time-rs.github.io#759)    /// assert_eq!(date!(-4713-11-24).to_julian_day(), 0);
[760](https://time-rs.github.io#760)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2000-01-01).to_julian_day(), 2_451_545);
[761](https://time-rs.github.io#761)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-01-01).to_julian_day(), 2_458_485);
[762](https://time-rs.github.io#762)    /// assert_eq!(date!(2019-12-31).to_julian_day(), 2_458_849);
[763](https://time-rs.github.io#763)    /// ```
[764](https://time-rs.github.io#764)    #[inline]
[765](https://time-rs.github.io#765)    pub const fn to_julian_day(self) -> [i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html) {
[766](https://time-rs.github.io#766)        let (year, ordinal) = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#765).[to_ordinal_date](https://time-rs.github.io#538-540)();
[767](https://time-rs.github.io#767)
[768](https://time-rs.github.io#768)        // The algorithm requires a non-negative year. Add the lowest value to make it so. This is
[769](https://time-rs.github.io#769)        // adjusted for at the end with the final subtraction.
[770](https://time-rs.github.io#770)        let adj_year = [year](https://time-rs.github.io#766) + 999_999;
[771](https://time-rs.github.io#771)        let century = [adj_year](https://time-rs.github.io#770) / 100;
[772](https://time-rs.github.io#772)
[773](https://time-rs.github.io#773)        let days_before_year = (1461 * [adj_year](https://time-rs.github.io#770) as [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html) / 4) as [i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html) - [century](https://time-rs.github.io#771) + [century](https://time-rs.github.io#771) / 4;
[774](https://time-rs.github.io#774)        [days_before_year](https://time-rs.github.io#773) + [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#766) as [i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html) - 363_521_075
[775](https://time-rs.github.io#775)    }

[12](https://time-rs.github.io#12)
[13](https://time-rs.github.io#13)/// A measurement of a monotonically non-decreasing clock. Opaque and useful only with [`Duration`].
[14](https://time-rs.github.io#14)///
[15](https://time-rs.github.io#15)/// Instants are always guaranteed to be no less than any previously measured instant when created,
[16](https://time-rs.github.io#16)/// and are often useful for tasks such as measuring benchmarks or timing how long an operation
[17](https://time-rs.github.io#17)/// takes.
[18](https://time-rs.github.io#18)///
[19](https://time-rs.github.io#19)/// Note, however, that instants are not guaranteed to be **steady**. In other words, each tick of
[20](https://time-rs.github.io#20)/// the underlying clock may not be the same length (e.g. some seconds may be longer than others).
[21](https://time-rs.github.io#21)/// An instant may jump forwards or experience time dilation (slow down or speed up), but it will
[22](https://time-rs.github.io#22)/// never go backwards.
[23](https://time-rs.github.io#23)///
[24](https://time-rs.github.io#24)/// Instants are opaque types that can only be compared to one another. There is no method to get
[25](https://time-rs.github.io#25)/// "the number of seconds" from an instant. Instead, it only allows measuring the duration between
[26](https://time-rs.github.io#26)/// two instants (or comparing two instants).
[27](https://time-rs.github.io#27)///
[28](https://time-rs.github.io#28)/// This implementation allows for operations with signed [`Duration`]s, but is otherwise identical
[29](https://time-rs.github.io#29)/// to [`std::time::Instant`].
[30](https://time-rs.github.io#30)#[doc(hidden)]
[31](https://time-rs.github.io#31)#[deprecated(
[32](https://time-rs.github.io#32)    since = "0.3.35",
[33](https://time-rs.github.io#33)    note = "import `std::time::Instant` and `time::ext::InstantExt` instead"
[34](https://time-rs.github.io#34))]
[35](https://time-rs.github.io#35)#[repr(transparent)]
[36](https://time-rs.github.io#36)#[derive([Debug](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/fmt/macros/derive.Debug.html), [Clone](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/clone/derive.Clone.html), [Copy](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/marker/derive.Copy.html), [PartialEq](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/cmp/derive.PartialEq.html), [Eq](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/cmp/derive.Eq.html), [PartialOrd](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/cmp/derive.PartialOrd.html), [Ord](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/cmp/derive.Ord.html), [Hash](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/hash/macros/derive.Hash.html))]

[655](https://time-rs.github.io#655)    /// Computes `self + duration`, saturating value on overflow.
[656](https://time-rs.github.io#656)    ///
[657](https://time-rs.github.io#657)    /// ```
[658](https://time-rs.github.io#658)    /// # use time::{PrimitiveDateTime, ext::NumericalDuration};
[659](https://time-rs.github.io#659)    /// # use time_macros::datetime;
[660](https://time-rs.github.io#660)    /// assert_eq!(
[661](https://time-rs.github.io#661)    ///     PrimitiveDateTime::MIN.saturating_add((-2).days()),
[662](https://time-rs.github.io#662)    ///     PrimitiveDateTime::MIN
[663](https://time-rs.github.io#663)    /// );
[664](https://time-rs.github.io#664)    ///
[665](https://time-rs.github.io#665)    /// assert_eq!(
[666](https://time-rs.github.io#666)    ///     PrimitiveDateTime::MAX.saturating_add(2.days()),
[667](https://time-rs.github.io#667)    ///     PrimitiveDateTime::MAX
[668](https://time-rs.github.io#668)    /// );
[669](https://time-rs.github.io#669)    ///
[670](https://time-rs.github.io#670)    /// assert_eq!(
[671](https://time-rs.github.io#671)    ///     datetime!(2019-11-25 15:30).saturating_add(27.hours()),
[672](https://time-rs.github.io#672)    ///     datetime!(2019-11-26 18:30)
[673](https://time-rs.github.io#673)    /// );
[674](https://time-rs.github.io#674)    /// ```
[675](https://time-rs.github.io#675)    #[inline]
[676](https://time-rs.github.io#676)    pub const fn saturating_add(self, duration: [Duration](https://time-rs.github.io/duration.rs.html#50-57)) -> Self {
[677](https://time-rs.github.io#677)        if let [Some](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html#variant.Some)(datetime) = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#676).[checked_add](https://time-rs.github.io#610-622)([duration](https://time-rs.github.io#676)) {
[678](https://time-rs.github.io#678)            [datetime](https://time-rs.github.io#677)
[679](https://time-rs.github.io#679)        } else if [duration](https://time-rs.github.io#676).[is_negative](https://time-rs.github.io/duration.rs.html#340-342)() {
[680](https://time-rs.github.io#680)            Self::[MIN](https://time-rs.github.io#119-122)
[681](https://time-rs.github.io#681)        } else {
[682](https://time-rs.github.io#682)            Self::[MAX](https://time-rs.github.io#151-154)
[683](https://time-rs.github.io#683)        }
[684](https://time-rs.github.io#684)    }

[686](https://time-rs.github.io#686)    /// Computes `self - duration`, saturating value on overflow.

[688](https://time-rs.github.io#688)    /// ```
[689](https://time-rs.github.io#689)    /// # use time::{PrimitiveDateTime, ext::NumericalDuration};
[690](https://time-rs.github.io#690)    /// # use time_macros::datetime;
[691](https://time-rs.github.io#691)    /// assert_eq!(
[692](https://time-rs.github.io#692)    ///     PrimitiveDateTime::MIN.saturating_sub(2.days()),
[693](https://time-rs.github.io#693)    ///     PrimitiveDateTime::MIN
[694](https://time-rs.github.io#694)    /// );
[695](https://time-rs.github.io#695)    ///
[696](https://time-rs.github.io#696)    /// assert_eq!(
[697](https://time-rs.github.io#697)    ///     PrimitiveDateTime::MAX.saturating_sub((-2).days()),
[698](https://time-rs.github.io#698)    ///     PrimitiveDateTime::MAX
[699](https://time-rs.github.io#699)    /// );
[700](https://time-rs.github.io#700)    ///
[701](https://time-rs.github.io#701)    /// assert_eq!(
[702](https://time-rs.github.io#702)    ///     datetime!(2019-11-25 15:30).saturating_sub(27.hours()),
[703](https://time-rs.github.io#703)    ///     datetime!(2019-11-24 12:30)
[704](https://time-rs.github.io#704)    /// );
[705](https://time-rs.github.io#705)    /// ```
[706](https://time-rs.github.io#706)    #[inline]
[707](https://time-rs.github.io#707)    pub const fn saturating_sub(self, duration: [Duration](https://time-rs.github.io/duration.rs.html#50-57)) -> Self {
[708](https://time-rs.github.io#708)        if let [Some](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html#variant.Some)(datetime) = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#707).[checked_sub](https://time-rs.github.io#641-653)([duration](https://time-rs.github.io#707)) {
[709](https://time-rs.github.io#709)            [datetime](https://time-rs.github.io#708)
[710](https://time-rs.github.io#710)        } else if [duration](https://time-rs.github.io#707).[is_negative](https://time-rs.github.io/duration.rs.html#340-342)() {
[711](https://time-rs.github.io#711)            Self::[MAX](https://time-rs.github.io#151-154)
[712](https://time-rs.github.io#712)        } else {
[713](https://time-rs.github.io#713)            Self::[MIN](https://time-rs.github.io#119-122)
[714](https://time-rs.github.io#714)        }
[715](https://time-rs.github.io#715)    }

[219](https://time-rs.github.io#219)    /// Attempt to create a `Time` from the hour, minute, second, and millisecond.
[220](https://time-rs.github.io#220)    ///
[221](https://time-rs.github.io#221)    /// ```rust
[222](https://time-rs.github.io#222)    /// # use time::Time;
[223](https://time-rs.github.io#223)    /// assert!(Time::from_hms_milli(1, 2, 3, 4).is_ok());
[224](https://time-rs.github.io#224)    /// ```
[225](https://time-rs.github.io#225)    ///
[226](https://time-rs.github.io#226)    /// ```rust
[227](https://time-rs.github.io#227)    /// # use time::Time;
[228](https://time-rs.github.io#228)    /// assert!(Time::from_hms_milli(24, 0, 0, 0).is_err()); // 24 isn't a valid hour.
[229](https://time-rs.github.io#229)    /// assert!(Time::from_hms_milli(0, 60, 0, 0).is_err()); // 60 isn't a valid minute.
[230](https://time-rs.github.io#230)    /// assert!(Time::from_hms_milli(0, 0, 60, 0).is_err()); // 60 isn't a valid second.
[231](https://time-rs.github.io#231)    /// assert!(Time::from_hms_milli(0, 0, 0, 1_000).is_err()); // 1_000 isn't a valid millisecond.

[684](https://time-rs.github.io#684)    /// Replace the clock hour.
[685](https://time-rs.github.io#685)    ///
[686](https://time-rs.github.io#686)    /// ```rust

[691](https://time-rs.github.io#691)    /// );
[692](https://time-rs.github.io#692)    /// assert!(time!(01:02:03.004_005_006).replace_hour(24).is_err()); // 24 isn't a valid hour
[693](https://time-rs.github.io#693)    /// ```
[694](https://time-rs.github.io#694)    #[must_use = "This method does not mutate the original `Time`."]
[695](https://time-rs.github.io#695)    #[inline]
[696](https://time-rs.github.io#696)    pub const fn replace_hour(mut self, hour: [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html)) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<Self, error::[ComponentRange](https://time-rs.github.io/error/component_range.rs.html#11-17)> {
[697](https://time-rs.github.io#697)        [self](https://time-rs.github.io#696).hour = [ensure_ranged!](https://time-rs.github.io/internal_macros.rs.html#128-164)(Hours: hour);

[926](https://time-rs.github.io#926)    /// Parse a `Time` from the input using the provided [format
[927](https://time-rs.github.io#927)    /// description](crate::format_description).
[928](https://time-rs.github.io#928)    ///
[929](https://time-rs.github.io#929)    /// ```rust
[930](https://time-rs.github.io#930)    /// # use time::Time;
[931](https://time-rs.github.io#931)    /// # use time_macros::{time, format_description};

[933](https://time-rs.github.io#933)    /// assert_eq!(Time::parse("12:00:00", &format)?, time!(12:00));

[53](https://time-rs.github.io#53)/// This type represents a point in time as a number of seconds and nanoseconds elapsed since the
[54](https://time-rs.github.io#54)/// Unix epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC). Negative values represent times before the Unix epoch.

[210](https://time-rs.github.io#210)        const MAX: [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html) = [Seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#32)::MAX.get() * [Millisecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Millisecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Millisecond.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html))
[211](https://time-rs.github.io#211)            + ([Nanoseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#33)::MAX.get() as [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)) / [Nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Nanosecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Nanosecond.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Millisecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Millisecond.html));
[212](https://time-rs.github.io#212)        const MIN: [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html) = [Seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#32)::MIN.get() * [Millisecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Millisecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Millisecond.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html))
[213](https://time-rs.github.io#213)            + ([Nanoseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#33)::MIN.get() as [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)) / [Nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Nanosecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Nanosecond.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Millisecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Millisecond.html));
[214](https://time-rs.github.io#214)
[215](https://time-rs.github.io#215)        [ensure_ranged!](https://time-rs.github.io/internal_macros.rs.html#128-164)(ri64<MIN, MAX>: milliseconds);
[216](https://time-rs.github.io#216)
[217](https://time-rs.github.io#217)        let mut seconds = [milliseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#209) / [Millisecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Millisecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Millisecond.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html));
[218](https://time-rs.github.io#218)        let nanoseconds = ([milliseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#209).[rem_euclid](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.i64.html#method.rem_euclid)([Millisecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Millisecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Millisecond.html#method.per_t)([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)))
[219](https://time-rs.github.io#219)            * [Nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Nanosecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Nanosecond.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Millisecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Millisecond.html))) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[220](https://time-rs.github.io#220)
[221](https://time-rs.github.io#221)        if [milliseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#209) < 0 && [nanoseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#218) != 0 {
[222](https://time-rs.github.io#222)            [seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#217) -= 1;
[223](https://time-rs.github.io#223)        }
[224](https://time-rs.github.io#224)

[226](https://time-rs.github.io#226)        [Ok](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html#variant.Ok)(unsafe { Self::[__new_unchecked](https://time-rs.github.io#147-155)([seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#217), [nanoseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#218)) })

[270](https://time-rs.github.io#270)        const MIN: [i128](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i128.html) = [Seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#32)::MIN.get() as [i128](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i128.html) * [Nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Nanosecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Nanosecond.html#method.per_t)::<[i128](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i128.html)>([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html))

[412](https://time-rs.github.io#412)    /// assert_eq!(timestamp!(1_546_398_245).date(), date!(2019-01-02));
[413](https://time-rs.github.io#413)    /// ```

[416](https://time-rs.github.io#416)        [self](https://time-rs.github.io#415).[to_utc](https://time-rs.github.io#327-336)().[date](https://time-rs.github.io/utc_date_time.rs.html#407-409)()

[419](https://time-rs.github.io#419)    /// Get the [`Time`] of the timestamp in UTC.
[420](https://time-rs.github.io#420)    ///
[421](https://time-rs.github.io#421)    /// ```rust
[422](https://time-rs.github.io#422)    /// # use time_macros::{time, timestamp};
[423](https://time-rs.github.io#423)    /// assert_eq!(timestamp!(1_546_398_245).time(), time!(3:04:05));
[424](https://time-rs.github.io#424)    /// ```
[425](https://time-rs.github.io#425)    #[inline]
[426](https://time-rs.github.io#426)    pub const fn time(self) -> [Time](https://time-rs.github.io/time.rs.html#59-85) {
[427](https://time-rs.github.io#427)        let within_day = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#426).[as_seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#353-355)().[rem_euclid](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.i64.html#method.rem_euclid)([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Second.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Day](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Day.html))) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[428](https://time-rs.github.io#428)
[429](https://time-rs.github.io#429)        let hour = [within_day](https://time-rs.github.io#427) / [Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Second.html#method.per_t)::<[u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html)>([Hour](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Hour.html));
[430](https://time-rs.github.io#430)        let minute =
[431](https://time-rs.github.io#431)            ([within_day](https://time-rs.github.io#427) - [hour](https://time-rs.github.io#429) * [Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Second.html#method.per_t)::<[u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html)>([Hour](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Hour.html))) / [Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Second.html#method.per_t)::<[u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html)>([Minute](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Minute.html));
[432](https://time-rs.github.io#432)        let second =
[433](https://time-rs.github.io#433)            [within_day](https://time-rs.github.io#427) - [hour](https://time-rs.github.io#429) * [Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Second.html#method.per_t)::<[u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html)>([Hour](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Hour.html)) - [minute](https://time-rs.github.io#430) * [Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Second.html#method.per_t)::<[u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html)>([Minute](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Minute.html));
[434](https://time-rs.github.io#434)
[435](https://time-rs.github.io#435)        // Safety: All values are guaranteed to be in range.
[436](https://time-rs.github.io#436)        unsafe {
[437](https://time-rs.github.io#437)            [Time](https://time-rs.github.io/time.rs.html#59-85)::[__from_hms_nanos_unchecked](https://time-rs.github.io/time.rs.html#162-177)(
[438](https://time-rs.github.io#438)                [hour](https://time-rs.github.io#429) as [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html),
[439](https://time-rs.github.io#439)                [minute](https://time-rs.github.io#430) as [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html),
[440](https://time-rs.github.io#440)                [second](https://time-rs.github.io#432) as [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html),
[441](https://time-rs.github.io#441)                [self](https://time-rs.github.io#426).[nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io#768-770)(),
[442](https://time-rs.github.io#442)            )
[443](https://time-rs.github.io#443)        }
[444](https://time-rs.github.io#444)    }
[445](https://time-rs.github.io#445)
[446](https://time-rs.github.io#446)    /// Compute the year, leap year status, and ordinal day of the timestamp in UTC.
[447](https://time-rs.github.io#447)    ///
[448](https://time-rs.github.io#448)    /// This algorithm is essentially identical to `Date::from_julian_day_unchecked`. Instead of
[449](https://time-rs.github.io#449)    /// returning `Date`, it returns the components as a tuple. By not bitpacking the values, it
[450](https://time-rs.github.io#450)    /// allows the compiler to see through the function boundary and better optimize methods.
[451](https://time-rs.github.io#451)    #[inline]
[452](https://time-rs.github.io#452)    const fn year_leap_ordinal(self) -> ([i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html), [bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html), [u16](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u16.html)) {
[453](https://time-rs.github.io#453)        const ERAS: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = 5_949;
[454](https://time-rs.github.io#454)        const D_SHIFT: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = 146097 * [ERAS](https://time-rs.github.io#453) + 719_528;
[455](https://time-rs.github.io#455)        const Y_SHIFT: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = 400 * [ERAS](https://time-rs.github.io#453);
[456](https://time-rs.github.io#456)
[457](https://time-rs.github.io#457)        const CEN_MUL: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = ((4u64 << 47) / 146_097) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[458](https://time-rs.github.io#458)        const JUL_MUL: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = ((4u64 << 40) / 1_461 + 1) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[459](https://time-rs.github.io#459)        const CEN_CUT: [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) = ((365u64 << 32) / 36_525) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[460](https://time-rs.github.io#460)
[461](https://time-rs.github.io#461)        let raw_day = [div_floor!](https://time-rs.github.io/internal_macros.rs.html#4-22)(self.as_seconds(), Second::per_t::<i64>(Day)) as [i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html);
[462](https://time-rs.github.io#462)
[463](https://time-rs.github.io#463)        let day = [raw_day](https://time-rs.github.io#461).[cast_unsigned](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.i32.html#method.cast_unsigned)().[wrapping_add](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.wrapping_add)([D_SHIFT](https://time-rs.github.io#454));
[464](https://time-rs.github.io#464)        let c_n = ([day](https://time-rs.github.io#463) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html) * [CEN_MUL](https://time-rs.github.io#457) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html)) >> 15;
[465](https://time-rs.github.io#465)        let cen = ([c_n](https://time-rs.github.io#464) >> 32) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[466](https://time-rs.github.io#466)        let cpt = [c_n](https://time-rs.github.io#464) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[467](https://time-rs.github.io#467)        let ijy = [cpt](https://time-rs.github.io#466) > [CEN_CUT](https://time-rs.github.io#459) || [cen](https://time-rs.github.io#465).[is_multiple_of](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.is_multiple_of)(4);
[468](https://time-rs.github.io#468)        let jul = [day](https://time-rs.github.io#463) - [cen](https://time-rs.github.io#465) / 4 + [cen](https://time-rs.github.io#465);
[469](https://time-rs.github.io#469)        let y_n = ([jul](https://time-rs.github.io#468) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html) * [JUL_MUL](https://time-rs.github.io#458) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html)) >> 8;
[470](https://time-rs.github.io#470)        let yrs = ([y_n](https://time-rs.github.io#469) >> 32) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[471](https://time-rs.github.io#471)        let ypt = [y_n](https://time-rs.github.io#469) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[472](https://time-rs.github.io#472)
[473](https://time-rs.github.io#473)        let year = [yrs](https://time-rs.github.io#470).[wrapping_sub](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.wrapping_sub)([Y_SHIFT](https://time-rs.github.io#455)).[cast_signed](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.cast_signed)();
[474](https://time-rs.github.io#474)        let ordinal = (([ypt](https://time-rs.github.io#471) as [u64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u64.html) * 1_461) >> 34) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html) + [ijy](https://time-rs.github.io#467) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[475](https://time-rs.github.io#475)        let leap = [yrs](https://time-rs.github.io#470).[is_multiple_of](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u32.html#method.is_multiple_of)(4) & [ijy](https://time-rs.github.io#467);
[476](https://time-rs.github.io#476)
[477](https://time-rs.github.io#477)        ([year](https://time-rs.github.io#473), [leap](https://time-rs.github.io#475), [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#474) as [u16](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u16.html))
[478](https://time-rs.github.io#478)    }

[594](https://time-rs.github.io#594)    pub const fn to_ordinal_date(self) -> ([i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html), [u16](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u16.html)) {

[614](https://time-rs.github.io#614)    /// Get the weekday of the timestamp in UTC.
[615](https://time-rs.github.io#615)    ///
[616](https://time-rs.github.io#616)    /// ```rust
[617](https://time-rs.github.io#617)    /// # use time::Weekday;
[618](https://time-rs.github.io#618)    /// # use time_macros::timestamp;
[619](https://time-rs.github.io#619)    /// assert_eq!(timestamp!(1_546_398_245).weekday(), Weekday::Wednesday);
[620](https://time-rs.github.io#620)    /// ```
[621](https://time-rs.github.io#621)    #[inline]
[622](https://time-rs.github.io#622)    pub const fn weekday(self) -> [Weekday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#17-32) {
[623](https://time-rs.github.io#623)        // 365,961,669 is obtained by starting with the smallest timestamp (with large-dates
[624](https://time-rs.github.io#624)        // enabled), dividing by 86,400 to get the number of days, then rounding down to get a
[625](https://time-rs.github.io#625)        // multiple of 7. This value is negated as we want to end with a positive number. Finally, 3
[626](https://time-rs.github.io#626)        // is added to shift the zero value to Monday, matching the internal representation of
[627](https://time-rs.github.io#627)        // `Weekday`.
[628](https://time-rs.github.io#628)        match ([div_floor!](https://time-rs.github.io/internal_macros.rs.html#4-22)(self.seconds.get(), 86_400) + 365_961_669) % 7 {
[629](https://time-rs.github.io#629)            0 => Weekday::[Monday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#19),
[630](https://time-rs.github.io#630)            1 => Weekday::[Tuesday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#21),
[631](https://time-rs.github.io#631)            2 => Weekday::[Wednesday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#23),
[632](https://time-rs.github.io#632)            3 => Weekday::[Thursday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#25),
[633](https://time-rs.github.io#633)            4 => Weekday::[Friday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#27),
[634](https://time-rs.github.io#634)            5 => Weekday::[Saturday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#29),
[635](https://time-rs.github.io#635)            6 => Weekday::[Sunday](https://time-rs.github.io/weekday.rs.html#31),
[636](https://time-rs.github.io#636)            _ => [unreachable!](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/macro.unreachable.html)(),
[637](https://time-rs.github.io#637)        }
[638](https://time-rs.github.io#638)    }

[772](https://time-rs.github.io#772)    /// Add a [`Duration`] to the timestamp. Returns `Overflow::Positive` or `Overflow::Negative` if
[773](https://time-rs.github.io#773)    /// the result is out of range.
[774](https://time-rs.github.io#774)    #[inline]
[775](https://time-rs.github.io#775)    const fn add(self, duration: [Duration](https://time-rs.github.io/duration.rs.html#50-57)) -> [Result](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/result/enum.Result.html)<Self, [Overflow](https://time-rs.github.io/util.rs.html#12-17)> {
[776](https://time-rs.github.io#776)        let (second_adj, nanoseconds) = if [duration](https://time-rs.github.io#775).[is_negative](https://time-rs.github.io/duration.rs.html#340-342)() {
[777](https://time-rs.github.io#777)            let nanos = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#775).nanoseconds.get() as [i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html) + [duration](https://time-rs.github.io#775).[subsec_nanoseconds](https://time-rs.github.io/duration.rs.html#1030-1032)();
[778](https://time-rs.github.io#778)            if [nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#777) < 0 {
[779](https://time-rs.github.io#779)                (-1, ([nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#777) + [Nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Nanosecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Nanosecond.html#method.per_t)::<[i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html)>([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html))) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html))
[780](https://time-rs.github.io#780)            } else {
[781](https://time-rs.github.io#781)                (0, [nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#777) as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html))
[782](https://time-rs.github.io#782)            }
[783](https://time-rs.github.io#783)        } else {
[784](https://time-rs.github.io#784)            let nanos = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#775).nanoseconds.get() + [duration](https://time-rs.github.io#775).[subsec_nanoseconds](https://time-rs.github.io/duration.rs.html#1030-1032)() as [u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html);
[785](https://time-rs.github.io#785)            if [nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#784) >= [Nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Nanosecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Nanosecond.html#method.per_t)([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)) {
[786](https://time-rs.github.io#786)                (1, [nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#784) - [Nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Nanosecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Nanosecond.html#method.per_t)::<[u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html)>([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)))
[787](https://time-rs.github.io#787)            } else {
[788](https://time-rs.github.io#788)                (0, [nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#784))
[789](https://time-rs.github.io#789)            }
[790](https://time-rs.github.io#790)        };
[791](https://time-rs.github.io#791)

[913](https://time-rs.github.io#913)    /// Checked addition of a [`Duration`], returning `None` if the result is out of range.
[914](https://time-rs.github.io#914)    ///
[915](https://time-rs.github.io#915)    /// ```rust
[916](https://time-rs.github.io#916)    /// # use time_macros::timestamp;
[917](https://time-rs.github.io#917)    /// # use time::ext::NumericalDuration as _;
[918](https://time-rs.github.io#918)    /// assert_eq!(
[919](https://time-rs.github.io#919)    ///     timestamp!(1_546_398_245).checked_add(1.days()),
[920](https://time-rs.github.io#920)    ///     Some(timestamp!(1_546_484_645))
[921](https://time-rs.github.io#921)    /// );
[922](https://time-rs.github.io#922)    /// assert_eq!(
[923](https://time-rs.github.io#923)    ///     timestamp!(1_546_398_245).checked_add((-1).days()),
[924](https://time-rs.github.io#924)    ///     Some(timestamp!(1_546_311_845))
[925](https://time-rs.github.io#925)    /// );
[926](https://time-rs.github.io#926)    /// ```
[927](https://time-rs.github.io#927)    #[inline]
[928](https://time-rs.github.io#928)    pub const fn checked_add(self, duration: [Duration](https://time-rs.github.io/duration.rs.html#50-57)) -> [Option](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html)<Self> {

[1272](https://time-rs.github.io#1272)
[1273](https://time-rs.github.io#1273)    /// Replace the nanoseconds within the second using a range-bounded integer to avoid range
[1274](https://time-rs.github.io#1274)    /// checks.
[1275](https://time-rs.github.io#1275)    #[inline]
[1276](https://time-rs.github.io#1276)    const fn replace_nanosecond_ranged(self, new_nanos: [Nanoseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#33)) -> Self {
[1277](https://time-rs.github.io#1277)        let (seconds, nanoseconds) = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#1276).[as_parts_ranged](https://time-rs.github.io#340-342)();
[1278](https://time-rs.github.io#1278)
[1279](https://time-rs.github.io#1279)        if [seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#1277).get() >= 0 || [nanoseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#1277).get() == 0 {
[1280](https://time-rs.github.io#1280)            Self::[new_ranged](https://time-rs.github.io#160-166)([seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#1277), [new_nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#1276))
[1281](https://time-rs.github.io#1281)        } else if [new_nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#1276).get() == 0 {
[1282](https://time-rs.github.io#1282)            // Safety: The previous conditional guarantees that `seconds` is negative (if it were
[1283](https://time-rs.github.io#1283)            // non-negative, we wouldn't be in this branch). Given that the maximum value is
[1284](https://time-rs.github.io#1284)            // positive, we can always add one without exceeding the maximum.
[1285](https://time-rs.github.io#1285)            Self::[new_ranged](https://time-rs.github.io#160-166)(unsafe { [seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#1277).unchecked_add(1) }, [new_nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#1276))
[1286](https://time-rs.github.io#1286)        } else {
[1287](https://time-rs.github.io#1287)            // Safety: Given the range of `new_nanos`, subtracting it from the maximum always
[1288](https://time-rs.github.io#1288)            // results in a value in range. Zero is excluded by a previous conditional.
[1289](https://time-rs.github.io#1289)            Self::[new_ranged](https://time-rs.github.io#160-166)([seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#1277), unsafe {
[1290](https://time-rs.github.io#1290)                [Nanoseconds](https://time-rs.github.io#33)::new_unchecked([Nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Nanosecond.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Nanosecond.html#method.per_t)::<[u32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u32.html)>([Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)) - [new_nanos](https://time-rs.github.io#1276).get())
[1291](https://time-rs.github.io#1291)            })
[1292](https://time-rs.github.io#1292)        }
[1293](https://time-rs.github.io#1293)    }
[1294](https://time-rs.github.io#1294)}
[1295](https://time-rs.github.io#1295)

[1300](https://time-rs.github.io#1300)    pub fn format_into(

[258](https://time-rs.github.io#258)    /// Convert the `UtcDateTime` from UTC to the provided [`UtcOffset`], returning an
[259](https://time-rs.github.io#259)    /// [`OffsetDateTime`].
[260](https://time-rs.github.io#260)    ///
[261](https://time-rs.github.io#261)    /// ```rust
[262](https://time-rs.github.io#262)    /// # use time_macros::{utc_datetime, offset};
[263](https://time-rs.github.io#263)    /// assert_eq!(
[264](https://time-rs.github.io#264)    ///     utc_datetime!(2000-01-01 0:00)
[265](https://time-rs.github.io#265)    ///         .to_offset(offset!(-1))
[266](https://time-rs.github.io#266)    ///         .year(),
[267](https://time-rs.github.io#267)    ///     1999,
[268](https://time-rs.github.io#268)    /// );
[269](https://time-rs.github.io#269)    ///
[270](https://time-rs.github.io#270)    /// // Construct midnight on new year's, UTC.
[271](https://time-rs.github.io#271)    /// let utc = utc_datetime!(2000-01-01 0:00);
[272](https://time-rs.github.io#272)    /// let new_york = utc.to_offset(offset!(-5));
[273](https://time-rs.github.io#273)    /// let los_angeles = utc.to_offset(offset!(-8));
[274](https://time-rs.github.io#274)    /// assert_eq!(utc.hour(), 0);
[275](https://time-rs.github.io#275)    /// assert_eq!(new_york.hour(), 19);
[276](https://time-rs.github.io#276)    /// assert_eq!(los_angeles.hour(), 16);
[277](https://time-rs.github.io#277)    /// ```
[278](https://time-rs.github.io#278)    ///
[279](https://time-rs.github.io#279)    /// # Panics
[280](https://time-rs.github.io#280)    ///

[282](https://time-rs.github.io#282)    #[inline]

[289](https://time-rs.github.io#289)    /// Convert the `UtcDateTime` from UTC to the provided [`UtcOffset`], returning an
[290](https://time-rs.github.io#290)    /// [`OffsetDateTime`]. `None` is returned if the date-time in the resulting offset is
[291](https://time-rs.github.io#291)    /// invalid.
[292](https://time-rs.github.io#292)    ///
[293](https://time-rs.github.io#293)    /// ```rust
[294](https://time-rs.github.io#294)    /// # use time::UtcDateTime;
[295](https://time-rs.github.io#295)    /// # use time_macros::{utc_datetime, offset};
[296](https://time-rs.github.io#296)    /// assert_eq!(
[297](https://time-rs.github.io#297)    ///     utc_datetime!(2000-01-01 0:00)
[298](https://time-rs.github.io#298)    ///         .checked_to_offset(offset!(-1))
[299](https://time-rs.github.io#299)    ///         .unwrap()
[300](https://time-rs.github.io#300)    ///         .year(),
[301](https://time-rs.github.io#301)    ///     1999,
[302](https://time-rs.github.io#302)    /// );
[303](https://time-rs.github.io#303)    /// assert_eq!(
[304](https://time-rs.github.io#304)    ///     UtcDateTime::MAX.checked_to_offset(offset!(+1)),
[305](https://time-rs.github.io#305)    ///     None,
[306](https://time-rs.github.io#306)    /// );
[307](https://time-rs.github.io#307)    /// ```
[308](https://time-rs.github.io#308)    #[inline]
[309](https://time-rs.github.io#309)    pub const fn checked_to_offset(self, offset: [UtcOffset](https://time-rs.github.io/utc_offset.rs.html#60-78)) -> [Option](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html)<[OffsetDateTime](https://time-rs.github.io/offset_date_time.rs.html#38-41)> {
[310](https://time-rs.github.io#310)        // Fast path for when no conversion is necessary.
[311](https://time-rs.github.io#311)        if [offset](https://time-rs.github.io#309).[is_utc](https://time-rs.github.io/utc_offset.rs.html#405-407)() {
[312](https://time-rs.github.io#312)            return [Some](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html#variant.Some)([self](https://time-rs.github.io#309).inner.[assume_utc](https://time-rs.github.io/primitive_date_time.rs.html#574-576)());
[313](https://time-rs.github.io#313)        }
[314](https://time-rs.github.io#314)
[315](https://time-rs.github.io#315)        let (year, ordinal, time) = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#309).[to_offset_raw](https://time-rs.github.io#332-365)([offset](https://time-rs.github.io#309));
[316](https://time-rs.github.io#316)
[317](https://time-rs.github.io#317)        if [year](https://time-rs.github.io#315) > [MAX_YEAR](https://time-rs.github.io/date.rs.html#38-42) || [year](https://time-rs.github.io#315) < [MIN_YEAR](https://time-rs.github.io/date.rs.html#32-36) {
[318](https://time-rs.github.io#318)            return [None](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html#variant.None);
[319](https://time-rs.github.io#319)        }
[320](https://time-rs.github.io#320)
[321](https://time-rs.github.io#321)        [Some](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html#variant.Some)([OffsetDateTime](https://time-rs.github.io/offset_date_time.rs.html#38-41)::[new_in_offset](https://time-rs.github.io/offset_date_time.rs.html#153-158)(
[322](https://time-rs.github.io#322)            // Safety: `ordinal` is not zero.
[323](https://time-rs.github.io#323)            unsafe { [Date](https://time-rs.github.io/date.rs.html#50-57)::[__from_ordinal_date_unchecked](https://time-rs.github.io/date.rs.html#123-127)([year](https://time-rs.github.io#315), [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#315)) },
[324](https://time-rs.github.io#324)            [time](https://time-rs.github.io#315),
[325](https://time-rs.github.io#325)            [offset](https://time-rs.github.io#309),
[326](https://time-rs.github.io#326)        ))

[329](https://time-rs.github.io#329)    /// Equivalent to `.to_offset(offset)`, but returning the year, ordinal, and time. This avoids
[330](https://time-rs.github.io#330)    /// constructing an invalid [`Date`] if the new value is out of range.
[331](https://time-rs.github.io#331)    #[inline]
[332](https://time-rs.github.io#332)    pub(crate) const fn to_offset_raw(self, offset: [UtcOffset](https://time-rs.github.io/utc_offset.rs.html#60-78)) -> ([i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html), [u16](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u16.html), [Time](https://time-rs.github.io/time.rs.html#59-85)) {
[333](https://time-rs.github.io#333)        let (second, carry) = [carry!](https://time-rs.github.io/internal_macros.rs.html#26-88)(@most_once
[334](https://time-rs.github.io#334)            self.second().cast_signed() + offset.seconds_past_minute(),
[335](https://time-rs.github.io#335)            0..Second::per_t(Minute)
[336](https://time-rs.github.io#336)        );
[337](https://time-rs.github.io#337)        let (minute, carry) = [carry!](https://time-rs.github.io/internal_macros.rs.html#26-88)(@most_once
[338](https://time-rs.github.io#338)            self.minute().cast_signed() + offset.minutes_past_hour() + carry,
[339](https://time-rs.github.io#339)            0..Minute::per_t(Hour)
[340](https://time-rs.github.io#340)        );
[341](https://time-rs.github.io#341)        let (hour, carry) = [carry!](https://time-rs.github.io/internal_macros.rs.html#26-88)(@most_twice
[342](https://time-rs.github.io#342)            self.hour().cast_signed() + offset.whole_hours() + carry,
[343](https://time-rs.github.io#343)            0..Hour::per_t(Day)
[344](https://time-rs.github.io#344)        );
[345](https://time-rs.github.io#345)        let (mut year, ordinal) = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#332).[to_ordinal_date](https://time-rs.github.io#547-549)();
[346](https://time-rs.github.io#346)        let mut ordinal = [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#345).[cast_signed](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.u16.html#method.cast_signed)() + [carry](https://time-rs.github.io#341);
[347](https://time-rs.github.io#347)        [cascade!](https://time-rs.github.io/internal_macros.rs.html#91-125)(ordinal => year);
[348](https://time-rs.github.io#348)
[349](https://time-rs.github.io#349)        [debug_assert!](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/macro.debug_assert.html)(ordinal > 0);
[350](https://time-rs.github.io#350)        [debug_assert!](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/macro.debug_assert.html)(ordinal <= days_in_year(year).cast_signed());
[351](https://time-rs.github.io#351)
[352](https://time-rs.github.io#352)        (
[353](https://time-rs.github.io#353)            [year](https://time-rs.github.io#345),
[354](https://time-rs.github.io#354)            [ordinal](https://time-rs.github.io#346).[cast_unsigned](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.i16.html#method.cast_unsigned)(),
[355](https://time-rs.github.io#355)            // Safety: The cascades above ensure the values are in range.
[356](https://time-rs.github.io#356)            unsafe {
[357](https://time-rs.github.io#357)                [Time](https://time-rs.github.io/time.rs.html#59-85)::[__from_hms_nanos_unchecked](https://time-rs.github.io/time.rs.html#162-177)(
[358](https://time-rs.github.io#358)                    [hour](https://time-rs.github.io#341).[cast_unsigned](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.i8.html#method.cast_unsigned)(),
[359](https://time-rs.github.io#359)                    [minute](https://time-rs.github.io#337).[cast_unsigned](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.i8.html#method.cast_unsigned)(),
[360](https://time-rs.github.io#360)                    [second](https://time-rs.github.io#333).[cast_unsigned](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/primitive.i8.html#method.cast_unsigned)(),
[361](https://time-rs.github.io#361)                    [self](https://time-rs.github.io#332).[nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io#762-764)(),

[376](https://time-rs.github.io#376)        let days = ([self](https://time-rs.github.io#375).[to_julian_day](https://time-rs.github.io#615-617)() as [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html) - [UNIX_EPOCH_JULIAN_DAY](https://time-rs.github.io#31) as [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html))
[377](https://time-rs.github.io#377)            * [Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Second.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Day](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Day.html));
[378](https://time-rs.github.io#378)        let hours = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#375).[hour](https://time-rs.github.io#686-688)() as [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html) * [Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Second.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Hour](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Hour.html));
[379](https://time-rs.github.io#379)        let minutes = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#375).[minute](https://time-rs.github.io#700-702)() as [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html) * [Second](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Second.html)::[per_t](https://time-rs.github.io/time_core/unit/struct.Second.html#method.per_t)::<[i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html)>([Minute](https://time-rs.github.io/time/convert/struct.Minute.html));
[380](https://time-rs.github.io#380)        let seconds = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#375).[second](https://time-rs.github.io#714-716)() as [i64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i64.html);
[381](https://time-rs.github.io#381)        [days](https://time-rs.github.io#376) + [hours](https://time-rs.github.io#378) + [minutes](https://time-rs.github.io#379) + [seconds](https://time-rs.github.io#380)

[766](https://time-rs.github.io#766)    /// Computes `self + duration`, returning `None` if an overflow occurred.
[767](https://time-rs.github.io#767)    ///
[768](https://time-rs.github.io#768)    /// ```rust
[769](https://time-rs.github.io#769)    /// # use time::{UtcDateTime, ext::NumericalDuration};
[770](https://time-rs.github.io#770)    /// # use time_macros::utc_datetime;
[771](https://time-rs.github.io#771)    /// assert_eq!(UtcDateTime::MIN.checked_add((-2).days()), None);
[772](https://time-rs.github.io#772)    /// assert_eq!(UtcDateTime::MAX.checked_add(1.days()), None);
[773](https://time-rs.github.io#773)    /// assert_eq!(
[774](https://time-rs.github.io#774)    ///     utc_datetime!(2019-11-25 15:30).checked_add(27.hours()),
[775](https://time-rs.github.io#775)    ///     Some(utc_datetime!(2019-11-26 18:30))
[776](https://time-rs.github.io#776)    /// );

[1198](https://time-rs.github.io#1198)    /// Parse an `UtcDateTime` from the input using the provided [format
[1199](https://time-rs.github.io#1199)    /// description](crate::format_description). A [`UtcOffset`] is permitted, but not required to
[1200](https://time-rs.github.io#1200)    /// be present. If present, the value will be converted to UTC.
[1201](https://time-rs.github.io#1201)    ///
[1202](https://time-rs.github.io#1202)    /// ```rust
[1203](https://time-rs.github.io#1203)    /// # use time::UtcDateTime;
[1204](https://time-rs.github.io#1204)    /// # use time_macros::{utc_datetime, format_description};
[1205](https://time-rs.github.io#1205)    /// let format = format_description!("[year]-[month]-[day] [hour]:[minute]:[second]");
[1206](https://time-rs.github.io#1206)    /// assert_eq!(
[1207](https://time-rs.github.io#1207)    ///     UtcDateTime::parse("2020-01-02 03:04:05", &format)?,
[1208](https://time-rs.github.io#1208)    ///     utc_datetime!(2020-01-02 03:04:05)
[1209](https://time-rs.github.io#1209)    /// );
[1210](https://time-rs.github.io#1210)    /// # Ok::<_, time::Error>(())
[1211](https://time-rs.github.io#1211)    /// ```
[1212](https://time-rs.github.io#1212)    #[inline]
[1213](https://time-rs.github.io#1213)    pub fn parse(
[1214](https://time-rs.github.io#1214)        input: &[str](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.str.html),

[1244](https://time-rs.github.io#1244)    /// A helper method to check if the `UtcDateTime` is a valid representation of a leap second.
[1245](https://time-rs.github.io#1245)    /// Leap seconds, when parsed, are represented as the preceding nanosecond. However, leap
[1246](https://time-rs.github.io#1246)    /// seconds can only occur as the last second of a month UTC.
[1247](https://time-rs.github.io#1247)    #[cfg(feature = "parsing")]
[1248](https://time-rs.github.io#1248)    #[inline]
[1249](https://time-rs.github.io#1249)    pub(crate) const fn is_valid_leap_second_stand_in(self) -> [bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html) {
[1250](https://time-rs.github.io#1250)        let dt = [self](https://time-rs.github.io#1249).inner;
[1251](https://time-rs.github.io#1251)
[1252](https://time-rs.github.io#1252)        [dt](https://time-rs.github.io#1250).[hour](https://time-rs.github.io/primitive_date_time.rs.html#457-459)() == 23
[1253](https://time-rs.github.io#1253)            && [dt](https://time-rs.github.io#1250).[minute](https://time-rs.github.io/primitive_date_time.rs.html#471-473)() == 59
[1254](https://time-rs.github.io#1254)            && [dt](https://time-rs.github.io#1250).[second](https://time-rs.github.io/primitive_date_time.rs.html#485-487)() == 59
[1255](https://time-rs.github.io#1255)            && [dt](https://time-rs.github.io#1250).[nanosecond](https://time-rs.github.io/primitive_date_time.rs.html#533-535)() == 999_999_999
[1256](https://time-rs.github.io#1256)            && [dt](https://time-rs.github.io#1250).[day](https://time-rs.github.io/primitive_date_time.rs.html#229-231)() == [dt](https://time-rs.github.io#1250).[month](https://time-rs.github.io/primitive_date_time.rs.html#215-217)().[length](https://time-rs.github.io/month.rs.html#70-72)([dt](https://time-rs.github.io#1250).[year](https://time-rs.github.io/primitive_date_time.rs.html#202-204)())
[1257](https://time-rs.github.io#1257)    }

# ConversionRange in time::error - Rust

Source: https://time-rs.github.io/api/time/error/struct.ConversionRange.html

`pub struct ConversionRange;`## Expand description

An error type indicating that a conversion failed because the target type could not store the initial value.

# lib.rs - source

# time/lib.rs

[1](https://time-rs.github.io#1)//! # Feature flags
[2](https://time-rs.github.io#2)//!
[3](https://time-rs.github.io#3)//! This crate exposes a number of features. These can be enabled or disabled as shown
[4](https://time-rs.github.io#4)//! [in Cargo's documentation](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/features.html). Features
[5](https://time-rs.github.io#5)//! are _disabled_ by default unless otherwise noted.
[6](https://time-rs.github.io#6)//!
[7](https://time-rs.github.io#7)//! Reliance on a given feature is always indicated alongside the item definition.
[8](https://time-rs.github.io#8)//!
[9](https://time-rs.github.io#9)//! - `std` (_enabled by default, implicitly enables `alloc`_)
[10](https://time-rs.github.io#10)//!
[11](https://time-rs.github.io#11)//!   This enables a number of features that depend on the standard library.
[12](https://time-rs.github.io#12)//!
[13](https://time-rs.github.io#13)//! - `alloc` (_enabled by default via `std`_)
[14](https://time-rs.github.io#14)//!
[15](https://time-rs.github.io#15)//!   Enables a number of features that require the ability to dynamically allocate memory.
[16](https://time-rs.github.io#16)//!
[17](https://time-rs.github.io#17)//! - `macros`
[18](https://time-rs.github.io#18)//!
[19](https://time-rs.github.io#19)//!   Enables macros that provide compile-time verification of values and intuitive syntax.
[20](https://time-rs.github.io#20)//!
[21](https://time-rs.github.io#21)//! - `formatting` (_implicitly enables `std`_)
[22](https://time-rs.github.io#22)//!
[23](https://time-rs.github.io#23)//!   Enables formatting of most structs.
[24](https://time-rs.github.io#24)//!
[25](https://time-rs.github.io#25)//! - `parsing`
[26](https://time-rs.github.io#26)//!
[27](https://time-rs.github.io#27)//!   Enables parsing of most structs.
[28](https://time-rs.github.io#28)//!
[29](https://time-rs.github.io#29)//! - `local-offset` (_implicitly enables `std`_)
[30](https://time-rs.github.io#30)//!
[31](https://time-rs.github.io#31)//!   This feature enables a number of methods that allow obtaining the system's UTC offset.
[32](https://time-rs.github.io#32)//!
[33](https://time-rs.github.io#33)//! - `large-dates`
[34](https://time-rs.github.io#34)//!
[35](https://time-rs.github.io#35)//!   By default, only years within the ±9999 range (inclusive) are supported. If you need support
[36](https://time-rs.github.io#36)//!   for years outside this range, consider enabling this feature; the supported range will be
[37](https://time-rs.github.io#37)//!   increased to ±999,999.
[38](https://time-rs.github.io#38)//!
[39](https://time-rs.github.io#39)//!   Note that enabling this feature has some costs, as it means forgoing some optimizations.
[40](https://time-rs.github.io#40)//!   Ambiguities may be introduced when parsing that would not otherwise exist.
[41](https://time-rs.github.io#41)//!
[42](https://time-rs.github.io#42)//! - `serde`
[43](https://time-rs.github.io#43)//!
[44](https://time-rs.github.io#44)//!   Enables [`serde`](https://docs.rs/serde) support for all types.
[45](https://time-rs.github.io#45)//!
[46](https://time-rs.github.io#46)//! - `serde-human-readable` (_implicitly enables `serde`, `formatting`, and `parsing`_)
[47](https://time-rs.github.io#47)//!
[48](https://time-rs.github.io#48)//!   Allows `serde` representations to use a human-readable format. This is determined by the
[49](https://time-rs.github.io#49)//!   serializer, not the user. If this feature is not enabled or if the serializer requests a
[50](https://time-rs.github.io#50)//!   non-human-readable format, a format optimized for binary representation will be used.
[51](https://time-rs.github.io#51)//!
[52](https://time-rs.github.io#52)//!   Libraries should never enable this feature, as the decision of what format to use should be up
[53](https://time-rs.github.io#53)//!   to the user.
[54](https://time-rs.github.io#54)//!
[55](https://time-rs.github.io#55)//! - `rand` (_implicitly enables `rand08`, `rand09`, and `rand010`_)
[56](https://time-rs.github.io#56)//!
[57](https://time-rs.github.io#57)//!   Previously, this would enable support for `rand` 0.8. Since the release of `rand` 0.9, the
[58](https://time-rs.github.io#58)//!   feature has been split into `rand08` and `rand09` to allow support for both versions. `rand`
[59](https://time-rs.github.io#59)//!   0.10 has since been added. For backwards compatibility and simplicity, this feature enables
[60](https://time-rs.github.io#60)//!   support for _all_ series.
[61](https://time-rs.github.io#61)//!
[62](https://time-rs.github.io#62)//!   It is strongly recommended to enable the version you need directly, as enabling `rand` will
[63](https://time-rs.github.io#63)//!   needlessly pull in all versions.
[64](https://time-rs.github.io#64)//!
[65](https://time-rs.github.io#65)//! - `rand08`, `rand09`, `rand010`
[66](https://time-rs.github.io#66)//!
[67](https://time-rs.github.io#67)//!   Enables [`rand` 0.8](https://docs.rs/rand/0.8), [`rand` 0.9](https://docs.rs/rand/0.9), and
[68](https://time-rs.github.io#68)//!   [`rand` 0.10](https://docs.rs/rand/0.10) support for all types, respectively.
[69](https://time-rs.github.io#69)//!
[70](https://time-rs.github.io#70)//! - `quickcheck` (_implicitly enables `alloc`_)
[71](https://time-rs.github.io#71)//!
[72](https://time-rs.github.io#72)//!   Enables [quickcheck](https://docs.rs/quickcheck) support for all types.
[73](https://time-rs.github.io#73)//!
[74](https://time-rs.github.io#74)//! - `wasm-bindgen`
[75](https://time-rs.github.io#75)//!
[76](https://time-rs.github.io#76)//!   Enables [`wasm-bindgen`](https://github.com/rustwasm/wasm-bindgen) support for converting
[77](https://time-rs.github.io#77)//!   [JavaScript dates](https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-bindgen/api/js_sys/struct.Date.html), as
[78](https://time-rs.github.io#78)//!   well as obtaining the UTC offset from JavaScript.

# Date in time::date - Rust

Source: https://time-rs.github.io/internal-api/time/date/struct.Date.html

## Expand description

Date in the proleptic Gregorian calendar.

By default, years between ±9999 inclusive are representable. This can be expanded to ±999,999
inclusive by enabling the `large-dates` crate feature. Doing so has performance implications
and introduces some ambiguities when parsing.

## Fields[§](https://time-rs.github.io#fields)

[§](https://time-rs.github.io#structfield.value)

`value: `[NonZero](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/num/nonzero/struct.NonZero.html)<[i32](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.i32.html)>Bitpacked field containing the year, ordinal, and whether the year is a leap year.

## Implementations[§](https://time-rs.github.io#implementations)

The minimum valid `Date`.

The value of this may vary depending on the feature flags enabled.

The maximum valid `Date`.

The value of this may vary depending on the feature flags enabled.

Provide a representation of `Date` as a `i32`. This value can be used for equality, hashing,
and ordering.

**Note**: This value is explicitly signed, so do not cast this to or treat this as an
unsigned integer. Doing so will lead to incorrect results for values with differing
signs.

#### const fn [is_in_leap_year](https://time-rs.github.io#method.is_in_leap_year)(self) -> [bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)

Whether `is_leap_year(self.year())` is `true`.
